content.comment_body: Thanks for your response. I have an additional question. The data log CSV file can be accessed using the "Tools > Transfers > Upload Data Log" option in [product_name] or by removing the SD card and reading it on a laptop. Are there other possible ways to access the CSV file, such as through a web server, Modbus interface, or display?
Yes, this function allows you to upload the CSV file from the SD card. Other methods are not available.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion revolves around ways to retrieve the data log CSV file from [product_name] devices. Users are unsure about alternative access methods beyond those officially described, and forum replies indicate limited support for web server, Modbus, or display-based retrieval of the file.
analysis.user_expectations: Users would like more remote or convenient options for accessing the CSV file, including via web server, Modbus, or directly from the device display.
